structured.approach: Followed the frontend-steps FE-04 procedure. I read every contracted input (task.components, feat.design, feat.stories, feat.screens, org.design_library, org.engineering_stack, org.lessons) and the repository files ci.mjs, package.json, README.md and CLAUDE.md. I implemented exactly the components listed in task.components section 3.1 (items 1.1 to 1.9) inside src/ap_portal/index.js, following the feat.design B4.2 algorithm and the exact markup in feat.screens FS-1 and FS-2. All changes are additive; existing code is untouched. I wrote docs/ap_portal.md (exports, signature, CT-1 inputs, outputs, TypeError cases, examples, private helpers) and updated README.md. I ran `node ci.mjs` before and after the docs edits. The code compiles, both existing tests pass and the static checks are clean. Coverage is below the threshold because CI measures coverage from tests/*.test.js only, and tests/ is outside this step's write scope; FE-05 writes the tests. I did not cover the gap by inventing tests elsewhere or padding the file. I recorded it, with a concrete test handoff, in task.code and as open questions. No connectors were needed and no secrets were used. Nothing was committed.
tools_used: Bash (node ci.mjs, git status, git diff)

claims.text: renderOverdueRisk was added to src/ap_portal/index.js and exported, with private helpers escapeHtml, toTwoDecimalString and riskClass and constants RISK_CLASSES and OVERDUE_HEADINGS, as the design places them.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for undefined, null or an empty array, throws TypeError for a non-array rows value or a non-integer days value, and otherwise renders <table class="overdue-risk">, a header row with no class (Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue, Amount) and one tr with class risk-<risk> per row, in the order given.
Amounts are displayed using string operations only: a decimal-string regex check plus padEnd to two decimals, never Number(), parseFloat or formatAmount, in line with D-2026-044 and L-011.
id and vendor are HTML-escaped (&, <, >, ", '), and the row class is allow-listed: any unknown risk value renders risk-unknown.
LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary are unchanged, and the existing public signatures are kept.
VERSION moved by a minor step from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0. package.json still says 2.3.0 because it is outside this step's write scope.
After the changes, node ci.mjs reports compile true, 2 tests run, 0 failures, no static issues, line coverage 61.02 and passed false; the uncovered lines are the new function bodies.
CI measures coverage from tests/*.test.js and requires coverage >= 90, but this step may change only src/ap_portal/, docs/ and README.md, so FE-05 must add the tests.
docs/ap_portal.md (module overview, signatures, inputs, outputs, errors, examples) was added and README.md was updated to list renderOverdueRisk.

open_questions: CQ-FE-5: CI line coverage is 61.02, below the required 90, after FE-04. CI measures coverage only from tests/*.test.js, which is outside this step's write scope. FE-05 must add the tests listed in task.code section 5 before FE-06 commits and pushes. This is not blocking for FE-04, but CI is red until then.

CQ-FE-4: package.json "version" (still 2.3.0) must move with VERSION (now 2.4.0), but package.json is outside FE-04's write scope. Should FE-05 or FE-06 update it, or should the spine widen the scope?
CQ-FE-3 (carried): the Developer needs to confirm the version number 2.4.0.

Carried, non-blocking: CQ-FE-1 (who styles the risk-* classes), CQ-FE-2 (no approved Figma frames), RA-1 (branch name feature/story), and TQ-7, TQ-11, OQ-B8, TQ-6, OQ-B9, PQ-P7, DQ-3, which are implemented on their interim designs.
structured.summary: I implemented STORY-07 in ap_portal on feature/story, but `node ci.mjs` fails: line coverage is 61.02 and CI needs at least 90. The new code has no tests yet because this step can't change tests/; they're FE-05's job. The code compiles, both existing tests pass and there are no static issues. renderOverdueRisk and its private helpers were added to src/ap_portal/index.js, following feat.design B4 and the feat.screens FS-1/FS-2 markup. Amounts use string operations only; id and vendor are HTML-escaped; the risk class is allow-listed; the empty state returns ''. Existing functions are unchanged. VERSION is now 2.4.0, but package.json still says 2.3.0 because it's outside this step's scope. I added docs/ap_portal.md and updated README.md. task.code.md lists the changes, the CI result and the tests FE-05 needs to add. Nothing was committed.
